visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair tied in a half-up ponytail with a red bow performs an energetic dance on an outdoor stage. She is wearing a maroon patterned haori jacket over a white sports bra featuring a team logo and white high-waisted shorts with a red belt. The setting is a brightly lit baseball stadium with green grass and yellow barriers in the background. (2) She holds a pink and black microphone in her right hand, smiling broadly with eyes squinted as she moves her arms rhythmically. A man in a white uniform with a red bow tie briefly appears behind her, mirroring some of the high-energy movements. The camera remains in a medium shot, capturing her upper body and facial expressions clearly. (3) She puts on black sunglasses while continuing her dance routine, which involves jumping and arm-swinging. The background reveals a baseball field with some players in white uniforms visible in the distance. The lighting is natural and bright daylight, emphasizing the vibrant colors of her outfit and the stadium environment.
